reviews.goal: As ops, open the main call logs or call history view so I can scan recent inbound/outbound activity for my agents.

liked: explicit 'Agent' column for scanning team activity
explicit 'Issues' column for quick problem identification
expected call log interface with filters and column headers
tabs for different log types ('Calls' selected by default)
explicit 'User Sentiment' column for quality assessment
explicit 'Cost' column for operational efficiency tracking
columns for 'Time', 'Duration', 'Channel Type', 'Session ID', 'End Reason', and 'Session Status'

reviews.why_winner: Bland is the most likely choice for an Operations Manager like Maya because it explicitly includes an 'Agent' column, which is critical for scanning activity specific to her team. The 'Issues' column also provides immediate, actionable insights into call quality and problems, directly supporting her goal of monitoring agent performance and call health.
reviews.bland_gaps_vs_winner: To further enhance its offering, Bland could consider adding a 'User Sentiment' score to its call logs. This would provide an even more comprehensive view of call quality and customer satisfaction, complementing its existing 'Issues' column and providing deeper insights for agent coaching.
